phq9.title: PHQ-9 — Patient Health Questionnaire Depression Scale
phq9.instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
questions: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

gad7.title: GAD-7 — Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale
gad7.instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
questions: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it's hard to sit still
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

audit.title: AUDIT — Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test
audit.instructions: Please answer the following questions about your alcohol use in the past year.

questions.q: How often do you have a drink containing alcohol?
How many drinks containing alcohol do you have on a typical day when you are drinking?
How often do you have six or more drinks on one occasion?
How often during the last year have you found that you were not able to stop drinking once you had started?
How often during the last year have you failed to do what was normally expected from you because of drinking?
How often during the last year have you needed a first drink in the morning to get yourself going after a heavy drinking session?
How often during the last year have you had a feeling of guilt or remorse after drinking?
How often during the last year have you been unable to remember what happened the night before because you had been drinking?
Have you or someone else been injured as a result of your drinking?
options: Yes, but not in the last year

questions.q: Has a relative, friend, doctor, or other health care worker been concerned about your drinking or suggested you cut down?
options: Yes, but not in the last year

mmse.title: MMSE — Mini-Mental State Examination
mmse.instructions: Brief cognitive evaluation. Apply each item and record the score obtained.

items.q: What day of the week is it?
What place are we in now? (hospital, clinic...)
What floor or area are we on?
Register 3 words (ball, flag, tree) — 1 point per word recalled immediately
Serial 7s: 100-7=93, -7=86, -7=79, -7=72, -7=65 (1 point per correct answer, max 5)
Recall the 3 registered words (ball, flag, tree) — 1 point per word
Name objects: show watch and pencil (1 point each)
Repeat phrase: "No ifs, ands, or buts"
3-step command: take paper, fold it, place on floor (1 point each step)
Write a spontaneous sentence (subject, verb, meaning)
Copy figure of two interlocking pentagons

panss.title: PANSS — Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale
panss.instructions: Rate each item on a scale from 1 (absent) to 7 (extreme) based on the clinical interview.
